name: TAKE-OFF READY Button
automations: TAKE-OFF READY Button: (BUTTON AND [phase in ARMED] AND [limits 10,64] AND [B1232=1] AND [B1246=1]) -> A91 phase -> 9 TAKE-OFF READY

name: TAKE-OFF Button
automations: TAKE-OFF Button: (BUTTON AND [phase in TAKE-OFF READY] AND [mode in 0] AND [B1263=1]) -> A2 phase -> 1 TAKE-OFF

name: LANDING Button
automations: LANDING Button: (BUTTON AND [phase in TAKE-OFF/HOVER/RETURN HOME/NTC/HOLD/HDG/ROUTE] AND [mode in 0]) -> A3 phase -> 3 LANDING

name: HOLD Button
automations: HOLD Button: ((BUTTON OR [B1234=1]) AND [mode in 0] AND ([phase in NTC/HDG/ROUTE] OR ([phase in RETURN HOME] AND NOT [limits 22]))) -> A9 phase -> 4 HOLD; A82 set B1282 := 1.0

name: HOVER Button
automations: HOVER Button: (([phase in LANDING] OR ([phase in RETURN HOME] AND [limits 22])) AND (BUTTON OR [B1234=1])) -> A4 phase -> 5 HOVER

name: Secondary FBX Selected ON
automations: Secondary FBX Selected ON: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1301=1]) -> A10 set B1301 := 1.0; A32 set B1304 := 0.0; A8 set B1285 := 0.0 || Secondary FBX Selected OFF: (BUTTON AND [B1301=1]) -> A13 set B1301 := 0.0; A32 set B1304 := 0.0; A8 set B1285 := 0.0

name: Motors arm Software Enabl
automations: Motors arm Software Enable Button to OFF: (BUTTON AND [B1247=1]) -> A25 set B1247 := 0.0 || Motors arm Software Enable Button to On: ((BUTTON AND NOT [B1247=1]) OR [phase in STANDBY/TAKE-OFF READY/ARMED/INITIAL]) -> A28 set B1247 := 1.0

name: Servo Test button CMD
automations: Servo Test button CMD ON: BUTTON -> A97 set B1270 := 1.0

name: Trim stick
automations: Trim stick: BUTTON -> A33 block cmd sel 15

name: NAV LIGHTS SWITCH
automations: NAV Light Position ON: (BUTTON AND [B2199=0]) -> A36 GPIO 1 on; A38 set B2199 := 1.0 || NAV Light Position OFF: (NOT [B2199=0] AND BUTTON) -> A35 GPIO 1 off; A37 set B2199 := 0.0

name: RETURN HOME Button
automations: RETURN HOME Button: ([phase in HOLD/NTC/HDG/ROUTE/HOVER] AND [B1220=1] AND (BUTTON OR [B1235=1]) AND [mode in 0]) -> A26 phase -> 10 RETURN HOME

name: HDG
automations: HDG Button: (BUTTON AND [phase in HOLD/NTC/RETURN HOME/ROUTE] AND [mode in 0] AND NOT ([phase in RETURN HOME] AND [limits 22])) -> A29 phase -> 12 HDG

name: STROBE LIGHT SWITCH
automations: STROBE Light Position ON : (BUTTON AND [B2198=0]) -> A39 GPIO 2 on; A40 set B2198 := 1.0 || STROBE Light Position OFF: (BUTTON AND NOT [B2198=0]) -> A41 GPIO 2 off; A42 set B2198 := 0.0

name: SET IAS CMD MODE MINIMUM
automations: IAS CMD MODE MINIMUM: BUTTON -> A45 set U1002 := 1.0

name: SET IAS CMD MODE NOMINAL
automations: IAS CMD MODE NOMINAL: BUTTON -> A46 set U1002 := 0.0

name: IAS CMD MODE MAXIMUM BUTT
automations: IAS CMD MODE MAXIMUM: BUTTON -> A47 set U1002 := 2.0

name: IAS CMD MODE MANUAL BTN
automations: IAS CMD MODE MANUAL: BUTTON -> A48 set U1002 := 3.0

name: IAS ADD BTN MANUAL
automations: IAS MANUAL CHANGE UP CMD: BUTTON -> A49 set B1217 := 1.0; A48 set U1002 := 3.0

name: IAS MANUAL CHANGE DOWN CM
automations: IAS MANUAL CHANGE DOWN CMD: BUTTON -> A50 set B1218 := 1.0; A48 set U1002 := 3.0

name: LIDAR PWR SWITCH
automations: LIDAR ON Button: (BUTTON AND NOT [limits 72]) -> A53 set U1003 := 1.0; A61 set U1004 := 0.0 || LIDAR OFF Button: (BUTTON AND [limits 72]) -> A58 set U1003 := 0.0; A61 set U1004 := 0.0

name: ALT CMD Change ASL UP
automations: ALT CMD Change ASL UP: BUTTON -> A79 set B1251 := 1.0

name: LIDAR AUTO Mode
automations: LIDAR AUTO Mode ON Button: (BUTTON AND NOT [limits 73]) -> A62 set U1004 := 1.0 || LIDAR AUTO Mode OFF Button: (BUTTON AND [limits 73]) -> A63 set U1004 := 0.0

name: Request Onetime MSG butto
automations: Request Onetime MSG: BUTTON -> A31 set B1249 := 1.0; A43 user timer 6

name: Generator enable btn
automations: Generator enable ON: (BUTTON AND [B1705=0]) -> A67 set B1787 := 1.0 || Generator enable OFF: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1705=0]) -> A68 set B1787 := 0.0

name: Crank button
automations: Engine Crank: (BUTTON AND [phase in ARMED]) -> A56 set B1790 := 1.0, B1610 := 1.0

name: ALT CMD Change ASL Down
automations: ALT CMD change ASL Down: BUTTON -> A85 set B1252 := 1.0

name: ALT AFL MODE CMD
automations: ALT AFL MODE CMD ON: (BUTTON AND [B1250=0]) -> A86 set B1250 := 1.0 || ALT AFL MODE CMD OFF: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1250=0]) -> A87 set B1250 := 0.0

name: ALT CMD Change AGL UP
automations: ALT CMD Change AGL UP: BUTTON -> A79 set B1251 := 1.0

name: Manual ALT CMD state
automations: Manual ALT CMD state ON: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1253=1]) -> A88 set B1253 := 1.0 || Manual ALT CMD state OFF: (BUTTON AND [B1253=1]) -> A89 set B1253 := 0.0

name: ALT CMD Change AGL Down
automations: ALT CMD change AGL Down: BUTTON -> A85 set B1252 := 1.0

name: Align Motor to flight pos
automations: Align Motor to flight position CMD: (BUTTON AND [B1232=1]) -> A90 set R3199 := 8.0

name: Engine Panel Throttle Com
automations: Engine Panel Throttle Control Button ON: (BUTTON AND [B1300=0]) -> A78 set B1300 := 1.0 || Engine Panel Throttle Control Button OFF: (BUTTON AND NOT [B1300=0]) -> A80 set B1300 := 0.0

name: Clear Sticky Errors butto
automations: Clear Sticky Errors: BUTTON -> A92 CAN tx producer 2 msg 4; A93 CAN tx producer 2 msg 5

name: IAS Offset Calibration
automations: IAS Offset calibration: (BUTTON AND [phase in INITIAL]) -> A98 set B1274 := 1.0
